mapper.sql: id,connector_code AS connectorCode,knowledge_base_id AS knowledgeBaseId,name,connector_type AS type,base_url AS baseUrl,auth_type AS authType,username,secret,config_json AS configJson,status,last_test_status AS lastTestStatus,last_test_message AS lastTestMessage,last_test_time AS lastTestTime,last_sync_time AS lastSyncTime,last_sync_count AS lastSyncCount,sync_cron AS syncCron,next_fire_at AS nextFireAt,sync_status AS syncStatus,last_error AS lastError,created_by AS createdBy,created_time AS createdTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_connector_source WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, name, sync_cron AS syncCron FROM t_connector_source WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND sync_cron IS NOT NULL AND sync_cron <> '' AND sync_status IN ('IDLE','FAILED') AND (next_fire_at IS NULL OR next_fire_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_fire_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_connector_source SET sync_status='RUNNING' WHERE id=#{id} AND sync_status IN ('IDLE','FAILED')
UPDATE t_connector_source SET sync_status=#{status}, next_fire_at=#{nextFireAt}, last_error=#{message} WHERE id=#{id}
